bio.text: Teresa Benitez-Thompson is the Democratic candidate for Nevada's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, having won the Democratic primary over Gregg Kidd and nine other candidates.
She represented Assembly District 27 in Washoe County from 2010 to 2022 and was Assembly majority leader from 2016 until term limits ended her service.
When she announced her campaign she was chief of staff to Nevada Attorney General Aaron Ford, according to The Nevada Independent.

Born in California, she moved to Reno as a child, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nevada, Reno and a master's in social work from the University of Michigan, and worked as a licensed clinical social worker before entering elected office.
